Sect: Independent

Calling themselves the Elois, the True @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} claim to be the real heirs of their clan's founder, insisting the vampires who bear the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} name today descend instead from a bastard childe who diablerized their true progenitor. Sagacious and erudite scholars, the Elois once ruled Carthage as gods before its fall, and their long unlives since have been spent in cold, detached study rather than the passion their cousins are famed for. Their alliance with the Black Hand cult gave them shelter for a time; since that cult's collapse, the Elois have sought new accommodations, most notably an uneasy but productive alliance of shared interest with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ssX4b2JFXF2uegC3]{Followers of Set}.

Disciplines: Potence, Presence, Temporis

Advantage: The True Brujah command Temporis, the Discipline of time, alongside their cold intellect.

Disadvantage: The blood of the Eloi smothers a True Brujah's emotions; over time they lose all human warmth, growing detached and passionless (a permanent, deepening emotional deadness).

Organization: The bloodline is unknown to Kindred society at large, allowing its members to move covertly, sometimes posing as members of other clans. Dissension runs deep between ancient elders and those who wish to act, and recruitment has all but ceased as the bloodline's numbers slowly thin.
